USING THIS FOR A USE CASE WRITE-UP

The three screens on the bottom row each pair one of our designs with numbered callouts, and every callout carries the requirement id it satisfies. That pairing is what a use case needs: the screen, the behaviour, and the requirement the behaviour is answering.

The top row is the argument — what the market confirmed, what we were missing, and where we deliberately differ.

Source for every claim is linked in the repository at 'Competition audit/README.md'.

WHY THERE ARE NO COMPETITOR SCREENSHOTS

Vendor interfaces are third-party copyrighted material. Reproducing them here carries real risk and adds nothing: every finding rests on a documented statement, not on a rendering.

The screens shown are our own designs.
Reference screens — our designs, annotated with the requirements each one specifies.
